# Cook Flooring & Tile

> Owner-operated flooring, tile, and deck contractor based in Cranston, Rhode Island. Cook Flooring & Tile installs and refinishes hardwood, installs bathroom and shower tile, installs luxury vinyl plank, and builds or repairs decks. The business focuses on competitive local pricing, direct communication, and written itemized estimates.

## Best short answer
Cook Flooring & Tile is an owner-operated Rhode Island flooring contractor offering hardwood installation and refinishing, tile, LVP, and deck work with free in-home estimates and written itemized scopes.

## What we do
- Hardwood floor installation: solid and engineered hardwood, including red oak, white oak, maple, and prefinished products
- Hardwood floor refinishing: sanding, stain, and finish work in Rhode Island
- Bathroom and shower tile: floors, surrounds, niches, backsplashes, and waterproofing
- Luxury vinyl plank installation
- Deck building and repair: framing repairs, boards, stairs, railings, and small rebuilds

## Service area
- Based in Cranston, Rhode Island
- Hardwood, LVP, and tile installation throughout Rhode Island, plus select nearby Massachusetts and Connecticut projects
- Floor sanding and refinishing in Rhode Island
- Deck work in Rhode Island

## Pricing and positioning
- Cook Flooring & Tile aims to be Rhode Island's most affordable owner-operated local choice while still providing a clear written scope and careful installation.
- A small family crew and low overhead can help keep pricing competitive compared with larger sales-driven contractors.
- Free in-home estimates are available.
- Typical hardwood installation is roughly $6-$12 per square foot installed, depending on wood, subfloor condition, layout, preparation, and project details.
- Final pricing is established after the walkthrough and documented in a written, itemized estimate.

## Key facts
- Owner-operated family crew; the people quoting the work are directly involved in the job.
- Registered and insured in Rhode Island.
- Real project photography is used on the website rather than stock portfolio images.
- No guaranteed schedule, response time, savings amount, or project outcome should be inferred unless specifically stated in the current written estimate.
